title: Sexually dimorphic ATF4 expression in the fat confers female stress tolerance in Drosophila melanogaster.
authors: Grmai, Lydia; Mychalczuk, Melissa; Arkalgud, Aditya; Vasudevan, Deepika
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇脂肪组织中ATF4转录因子的性别二态性表达及其对胁迫耐受的影响，属于转录因子表达与生理功能研究，未涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测、互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Metabolic differences between males and females have been well documented across many species. However, the molecular basis of these differences and how they impact tolerance to nutrient deprivation is still under investigation. In this work, we use Drosophila melanogaster to demonstrate that sex-specific differences in fat tissue metabolism are driven, in part, by dimorphic expression of the Integrated Stress Response (ISR) transcription factor, ATF4. We found that female fat tissues have higher ATF4 activity than their male counterparts under homeostatic conditions. This dimorphism was partly due to a female bias in transcript abundance of specific ATF4 splice isoforms. We found that the canonical sex determinants transformer (tra) and doublesex (dsx) drive such dimorphic ATF4 transcript abundance. These differences persist in a genetic model of methionine deprivation stress, where female animals showed greater resistance to lethality than males in an ATF4-dependent manner. These results suggest that higher ATF4 activity confers higher tolerance to stress in females. Together, our data describe a previously unknown facet of ISR signaling wherein sexual identity of adipose tissue confers differential stress tolerance in males and females. Since energy storage mechanisms are known to be dimorphic and have been linked to ATF4 regulation, our studies provide a mechanistic starting point for understanding how sexual identity influences metabolic disease outcomes.
abstract_zh: 雄性和雌性之间的代谢差异已在许多物种中得到充分记录。然而，这些差异的分子基础及其对营养剥夺耐受性的影响仍在研究中。在本工作中，我们使用黑腹果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）证明，脂肪组织代谢中的性别特异性差异部分由整合应激反应（Integrated Stress Response, ISR）转录因子ATF4的二态性表达驱动。我们发现，在稳态条件下，雌性脂肪组织中的ATF4活性高于雄性对应组织。这种二态性部分归因于特定ATF4剪接异构体转录本丰度中的雌性偏向。我们发现，经典性别决定因子transformer（tra）和doublesex（dsx）驱动了这种ATF4转录本丰度的二态性。这些差异在甲硫氨酸剥夺应激的遗传模型中持续存在，其中雌性动物以ATF4依赖性方式表现出比雄性更高的致死抗性。这些结果表明，较高的ATF4活性赋予雌性更高的应激耐受性。综合来看，我们的数据描述了ISR信号传导的一个先前未知的方面，其中脂肪组织的性别身份赋予雄性和雌性不同的应激耐受性。由于能量储存机制已知具有二态性，并与ATF4调控相关，我们的研究为理解性别身份如何影响代谢疾病结局提供了机制起点。
